label: Pre-encounter — a fare who will not board
location: The Drowned Vault, the ferry landing

recentEvents.value: Crossings are suspended; the passengers who were mid-route were set down at the far docks and the boats turned back empty.
An armed stranger stands on his water, refusing the crossing out.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A passenger who will not board, will not leave, and will not drown — and who understands every word.

temporaryObjective.value: Carry this passenger, above all, back out.
